CHAPTER 1 · ITEM 09 / 10

Interaction, markets and government

Efficiency & equality效率與平等

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Distinguish efficiency from equality and identify the potential trade-off between them.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

效率問總收益是否最大；平等問收益如何分配。重新分配可能改善分配，同時改變工作或投資誘因。

Efficiency concerns the size of total economic benefits from resources. Equality concerns their distribution. Redistribution may improve equality while changing incentives and the total surplus; the trade-off depends on the policy.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A tax-transfer policy gives poorer households more income, but may reduce the reward to extra work. 轉移支付改善分配，也可能影響工作誘因。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A policy redistributes income while reducing total surplus. Which description fits? 重分配同時減少總剩餘？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
